correctness.rationale: PASS. Reconstructed the exact 28 nonline Fano-triple vertices and 42 disjointness edges, exhaustively branched on uncovered vertices to enumerate all 84 distinct 14-edge perfect matchings. Enumerated all 3,486 unordered matching pairs, decomposed each symmetric difference into even cycles, and built F_8 from the single (8) component and F_10 from the single (10) component. Obtained F_8=42K2 and 168 ten-switch edges with every vertex degree 4. BFS from all 84 vertices reaches all 84 with identical layer vector (1,4,12,25,28,13,1) and diameter/radius 6; exactly 42 distinct unique antipodal pairs and these coincide exactly with symmetric difference components (8,16), each eight-switch partner at ten-switch distance 5. Girth 7 excludes 2/4/6 alternating cycles; hence length 10 is sharp. This is an exact exhaustive finite verification with stated branching exhaustivity, not inference from sampled logarithms or logs.
